# Game Understanding Requirements Checklist

**Purpose**: Review whether the requirements give Cid enough direction to build and reuse useful game understanding within the player's limits.
**Created**: 2026-11-08
**Feature**: [Bounded game understanding pass](../spec.md)
**Note**: Generated by `$speckit-checklist` for a lightweight owner review before task generation.
**Review Ownership**: The reviewer marks an item `[x]` only after judging that the written requirement meets the criterion.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` records requirements quality. It does not establish implementation or observed coaching behavior.

## Completeness and acceptance criteria: substantive understanding

- [x] CHK001 Do the coverage requirements define what counts as the game's core loop, progression and major systems for games without quests, character builds or a linear progression path? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001–FR-003]
- [x] CHK002 Do the saved knowledge requirements distinguish the overview's explanation of how systems connect from the detail each topic must retain for later reasoning without reopening its sources? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, SC-001, SC-003]
- [x] CHK003 Do the acceptance criteria distinguish a consequential option with a concrete cost, benefit and readiness factor from a generic suggestion or a restatement of the next objective? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-004, FR-006, SC-002]
- [x] CHK004 Are documented progression gates, optional preparation strategies and inferred readiness advice distinguished clearly enough to avoid presenting a recommendation as a requirement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, FR-008]

## Clarity and alternate flows: questions and research bounds

- [x] CHK005 Does the initial interview requirement define how the game, goal and current situation determine which unanswered details matter most, including when the current objective is known but readiness is unclear? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, Story 2]
- [x] CHK006 Is the transition from broad understanding to targeted depth defined when a missing player detail blocks tailored advice but still allows useful general guidance? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, FR-006, FR-010]
- [x] CHK007 Are an adequate foundation and an early stop with partial coverage distinguishable by the explanation, questions and remaining gaps, without relying on source or topic counts? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §FR-009–FR-011, Story 4]
- [x] CHK008 Do the reduced-scope requirements distinguish a one-off quick answer or skipped question from a lasting research preference, and define when deferred work may become relevant again? [Alternate Flow, Spec §FR-012, FR-013, Edge Cases]

## Consistency and evidence: support, reuse and refresh

- [x] CHK009 Are the evidence or premise requirements clear for a verified relationship, a sourced strategy and an original deduction, including an overview statement that combines claims with different support? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007–FR-009, SC-004]
- [x] CHK010 Do the gap requirements say what to retain when evidence is inaccessible, no claim can be verified, or version coverage is unknown, without treating missing evidence as established fact? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-008–FR-010, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK011 Do the reuse requirements distinguish an adequate saved overview from a thin legacy one and specify when a new goal, progress stage or run warrants further research? [Coverage, Spec §FR-006, FR-013, Story 3]
- [x] CHK012 Is the scope of reassessment after a version change or conflict explicit for affected findings, overview claims and advice, including what remains reusable? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, FR-015, SC-006]

## Boundaries and recovery: player records and spoilers

- [x] CHK013 Are reusable game findings, playthrough-specific answers and advice, and scoped player preferences clearly separated when the same game is coached across runs or conversations? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, FR-013, FR-015, Story 3]
- [x] CHK014 Are spoiler requirements explicit for revealing questions, system explanations and source labels as well as direct answers, including when the player's knowledge boundary is uncertain? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001, FR-010, FR-015, Story 4]
- [x] CHK015 Are the recovery requirements clear when only part of the understanding can be saved, including how the spec distinguishes confirmed findings from an unsaved overview or run update and preserves existing records? [Recovery, Spec §FR-007, FR-015, Edge Cases]

## Notes

- Use the [specification](../spec.md) and the [game understanding contract](../contracts/game-understanding.md) together when reviewing the questions.
- Leave unresolved items unchecked and record the unclear or missing requirement next to the item.
- `$speckit-implement` reads checklist state as a gate and does not change reviewer marks.
- The [built-in requirements checklist](requirements.md) has its own lifecycle under `$speckit-specify` and `$speckit-clarify`.
- This is a review of the written requirements. Cid's personal-use feedback workflow does not require a behavioral trial campaign or AI testing.

## Completed requirements review — 2026-11-08

All 15 items were reviewed against the specification, pass contract and referenced
baseline rules. Clarifications make existing design intent explicit for nonlinear
progression, consequential options, mixed-support overview claims, deferred work,
partial coverage and per-file recovery. No implementation or coaching trial was
performed; these marks approve written requirements quality only.

Contract references below point to the [game understanding contract](../contracts/game-understanding.md).

| Item | Review evidence and judgment |
| --- | --- |
| CHK001 | Spec FR-002–FR-003; contract “Research and coaching behavior,” step 2 defines recurring actions/feedback and meaningful changes within matches/runs, skill or player goals, including absence of persistent progression. Major systems follow their impact on actual play. |
| CHK002 | Spec FR-007; contract “Saved output and reuse” requires topic mechanics, conditions, effects and limits sufficient for later reasoning, while the overview explains connections and their coaching implications. |
| CHK003 | Spec SC-002; contract research step 5 requires a feasible action with concrete benefit/cost and relevant readiness. Generic suggestions and next-objective facts alone explicitly fail. |
| CHK004 | Spec FR-004/FR-008; contract research step 3 separates evidenced gates, optional sourced preparation and inferred readiness deductions with premises and uncertainty. |
| CHK005 | Spec Story 2 scenario 1 and FR-005; contract research step 4 prioritizes missing details that change choices and rejects quest location as a readiness profile. |
| CHK006 | Spec FR-005/FR-006/FR-010; contract “Adequacy and stopping” switches to questions or supported conditional help when missing player context is the blocker, rather than continuing broad searches. |
| CHK007 | Spec Story 4 scenarios 1/3 and FR-010–FR-011; contract “Adequacy and stopping” distinguishes explanatory adequacy from partial stops by missing coverage, reason and useful next question/condition, without quotas. |
| CHK008 | Spec FR-012; contract “Entry and scope” distinguishes present limits from requested lasting scoped preferences and defines relevance-based revisiting without overriding refusals or inventing skipped answers. |
| CHK009 | Spec FR-008; contract “Saved output and reuse” distinguishes evidence for facts/strategies from retained premises for deductions and splits overview claims with differing support or applicability. |
| CHK010 | Spec Edge Cases and FR-009–FR-010; contract “Saved output and reuse” retains gaps, source access observations, run questions and unknown version limits without manufacturing a finding. Data model “Game understanding in existing v1 records” supplies the no-verified-claim representation. |
| CHK011 | Spec Story 3 scenarios 1–3 and FR-013; contract “Entry and scope” and “Saved output and reuse” assess content rather than file existence and deepen only material new goal/stage/interest/question needs. New runs reuse adequate game knowledge and collect their own context. |
| CHK012 | Spec Story 3 scenario 4, FR-014 and SC-006; contract “Saved output and reuse” reassesses affected premises, overview claims and dependent plans before reuse, preserving provenance and unaffected records; other runs reassess when loaded. |
| CHK013 | Spec Story 3 scenario 2, FR-013/FR-015 and Key Entities; contract “Entry and scope” and “Saved output and reuse” separate reusable knowledge, selected-run answers/plans and scoped preferences. Baseline coaching contract “Request and response behavior” defines scope precedence. |
| CHK014 | Spec Story 4 scenarios 3–4 and Edge Cases; contract “Saved output and reuse” covers questions, system explanations, headings, source labels/destinations and visuals, with neutral questions or reduced disclosure for an uncertain boundary. Baseline “Spoiler permissions” remains binding. |
| CHK015 | Spec FR-015 and Edge Cases; contract “Saved output and reuse” explicitly distinguishes confirmed topic saves from unsaved overview/run/preference updates. Its referenced baseline “Write and recovery contract” requires read-back, retained confirmed substeps and targeted reference repair without resetting prior records. |

**Unresolved requirements-quality items**: None.
**Implementation status**: Unchanged; this feature remains planned and unimplemented.
